title.narrative: Jharkhand Urban Water Supply Improvement Project

description.narrative: The proposed Jharkhand Urban Water Supply Improvement Project will support urban service improvement and policy initiatives of the Government of Jharkhand. The project will finance water supply infrastructure in the state capital of Ranchi, and three other towns (Hussainabad, Jhumri Telaiya, and Medininagar) located in economically and socially backward areas of Jharkhand. The Project will address capacity and institutional governance issues in the sector. This is ADB?s first urban sector Project in Jharkhand, and aligned to Jharkhand?s Vision & Action Plan, 2021 of developing sustainable cities that are spatially, economically, and socially inclusive, and India CPS of inclusive growth of low-income states.

description.narrative: Output/s as listed by the project staff.

Output: Institutional capacity for sustainable urban service delivery and urban governance improved Indicator: At least 100 community members (50 women) received vocational training for employable job skills in construction and O&M of water supply assets Progress/Status: Pre-training workshop on Skill development training has been imparted to 41 community members in the first phase. Data Source: Pre- and post-training survey assessment (through data collected from the questionnaires) Actual value:

Output: Institutional capacity for sustainable urban service delivery and urban governance improved Indicator: At least 500 community members (50% women) reported improved awareness on (i) water conservation, health, sanitation, and hygiene; (ii) the spread of epidemics or pandemics, such as COVID-19; and (iii) opportunities for prospective jobs in construction and O&M Progress/Status: Under Ranchi 2A -1101 Community consultation has been done on Safe drinking water, safety during construction work, house service connections, increasing women participation and developing leadership skills and gender equality to 4967 Female, 6016 Male and 2840 Indigenous people.
Under Ranchi 2C - 2 Community consultation has been done on Safe drinking water, safety during construction work, increasing women participation and developing leadership skills and gender equality to 45 Female, 17 Male and 31 Indigenous people.
At Hussainabad, 136 Community Consultation on distribution system, Safety during Construction, gender equality and participation of women to 993 Female, 523 Male and 367 Indigenous peoples.
At Medininagar, 80 Community Consultation on distribution system, Safety during Construction, gender equality and participation of women to 578 Female, 357 Male and 391 Indigenous peoples.
At Jhumri Telaiya, 74 Community Consultation on distribution system, Safety during Construction, gender equality and participation of women to 281 Female, 306 Male and 225 Indigenous peoples.
Data Source: Pre- and post-training survey assessment (through data collected from the questionnaires) Actual value:

Output: Institutional capacity for sustainable urban service delivery and urban governance improved Indicator: At least 70% of relevant staff of JUIDCO, SUDA, four project ULBs, and JUPMI (50% of whom are women staff) reported improved knowledge on (i) design and implementation of urban services, including response to climate risks; (ii) institutional development, urban governance, revenue generation, financial planning, and operational dimensions; and (iii) integrating gender equality and social inclusion features in urban services Progress/Status: Training module has been prepared. Data Source: Pre- and post-training survey assessment (through data collected from the questionnaires) Actual value:

Output: Water supply infrastructure in four project towns improved Indicator: 940 kilometers of water distribution network with climate-resilient features constructed and connected to 115,000 households (including 100% of households below the poverty line, households with scheduled caste and scheduled tribe members, and households with persons with disabilities) Progress/Status: For Ranchi 2A: • Physical Progress: 70.6% • Financial Progress: 64.5%
For Hussainabad water supply project: • Physical Progress: 48.5 • Financial Progress: 43.1%
Jhumri Telaiya WS Work: - Physical Progress: 42.0% - Financial Progress: 37.6%
Medininagar WS Work: - Physical Progress: 44.0% - Financial Progress: 42.6%
PMC for all Civil Works packages have been appointed and have already been mobilized at respective sites.
PMU Consultant have been mobilized on 28 September 2022. Data Source: Semi-annual progress reports, periodic ULB records, and household data collated through connection application forms. Actual value:

Output: Water supply infrastructure in four project towns improved Indicator: Four water treatment plants with a combined capacity of 275 million liters per day commissioned Progress/Status: Ranchi WS 2A - Physical progress: 70.6% - Financial progress: 64.5%
Hussainabad WS - Physical Progress: 48.5% - Financial Progress: 43.1%
Ranchi 2C Intake Work - Physical Progress: 23.9% - Financial Progress: 8.4%
Jhumri Telaiya WS Work - Physical Progress: 42.0% - Financial Progress: 37.6%
Medininagar WS Work - Physical Progress: 44.0% - Financial Progress: 42.6% Data Source: Semi-annual progress reports, periodic ULB records, and household data collated through connection application forms. Actual value:

Output: Institutional capacity for sustainable urban service delivery and urban governance improved Indicator: A sustainable water sector asset management strategy, including a volumetric tariff-based user charges policy for Jharkhand, prepared and approved by the UDHD, and implemented by four ULBs in four project towns Progress/Status: Contract for the Strategy Consultant for Sustainable Water Supply Assets Management (strategy consultant) was signed on 25 November 2022 and the signed contract was received by ADB on 3 December 2022. The strategy consultant has submitted Rapid requirement and technical assessment report for all 49 ULBs out of which reports of 40 ULBs have been approved and the rest reports are under review. The consultant submitted a project appraisal report for Ranchi cluster on 12 April 2024 on which JUIDCO has sought some information on which response is to be provided by the consultant. The consultant has also submitted project appraisal reports for Hazaribagh and Medininagar clusters on which are under review by JUIDCO. Data Source: Copy of approved water asset management strategy, user charges policy, and urban reforms policy framework, UDHD annual reports on ULB performance Baseline year: 2020 Baseline value: N Baseline year: 2020 Baseline value: N Target year: 2028 Target value: Y

Data Source: Project management information system Baseline year: 2020 Baseline value: Not applicable Baseline year: 2020 Baseline value: Not applicable Target year: 2028 Target value: Y
